name: Pacoima Center
demographics: Pacoima Center serves a diverse, family-oriented community with a population of 268,000+ within 3 miles. The trade area features households with an average income of $105,033, representing working and middle-class families seeking value-oriented shopping options. The center attracts approximately 4.9 million annual visits, drawing shoppers primarily interested in grocery, discount retail, and everyday essentials. The demographic profile skews toward budget-conscious consumers who prioritize convenience and value, with strong representation from multi-generational Hispanic households typical of the San Fernando Valley's Pacoima neighborhood.
description: Pacoima Center is a market-dominant community shopping center strategically located at 9727 Laurel Canyon Drive and Osborne Street in Pacoima, California. Spanning 215,930 square feet, this open-air retail destination is anchored by three major retailers: Food 4 Less, Target, and Ross Dress For Less, creating a powerful value-oriented shopping experience for the local community. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility, with over 32,000 vehicles per day passing on Osborne Street and 21,000+ on Laurel Canyon Boulevard, plus direct access to Interstate 5 which sees more than 310,000 vehicles daily. Managed by Brixmor Property Group, one of the nation's largest owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Pacoima Center serves a dense population of over 268,000 residents within a 3-mile radius. Additional tenants include Chase Bank, AutoZone, Starbucks, and Magicland Dental Group, providing a comprehensive mix of retail, financial, automotive, and service offerings that generate an impressive 4.9 million annual visits according to 2024 data.
summary: Pacoima Center is a 215,930 square foot community shopping center anchored by Food 4 Less, Target, and Ross Dress For Less, drawing 4.9 million annual visits. Located at a high-traffic intersection with direct I-5 access, the center serves over 268,000 residents within 3 miles with value-oriented retail and essential services.
